# opusdns_zones_summary (Data Source)

Returns aggregate counts for all DNS zones owned by the caller's organization (`GET /v1/dns/summary`). Useful for dashboards or conditional plan logic without paginating the full `opusdns_zones` list.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for this data source.
- `total_zones` (Number) Total number of DNS zones.
- `zones_by_dnssec` (Map of Number) Map of DNSSEC status (e.g. `enabled`, `disabled`) → zone count.
